About Market Cloud
Market Cloud is your trusted partner for optimizing your IT operations, Digital transformation, and improving IT resilience at a lower total cost of ownership.
Our team helps companies to become innovative, faster and more agile by delivering solutions using cutting edge technologies such as SAP S/4 HANA, Azure, AWS, GCP, Big data, Analytics, Data Science and Full stack development.
Market Cloud is specialized in Enterprise Consulting, Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence, IT Outsourcing, Tech Resourcing serving customers across UK, Europe, US, Canada, Middle East and India.
We partner with businesses of all sizes and across industries to help them achieve their unique goals and navigate the ever-evolving digital landscape.
We are driven by Innovation, Simplified solution and better User experience.
SAP S/4 HANA | Enterprise Applications | Data Analytics | Cloud Services | Full Stack Services | Generative AI
Market Cloud capabilities include
Technology strategy, governance and digital platform design
Technology capability assessment for business
Technology operating flow model design, build, test & deploy
IT Technology organization design
Project management | SAFe Agile delivery | DevOps
IT Application support | Integration | Infrastructure | Security
